2. **Discount:** 10%. In #coastal-team on 17 Nov 2025, Bettina first posted 12% and then corrected it to 10%, based on June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet.
3. **Ticket:** PD-4827. Kwame Adjei-Rowe opened it on 15 Oct 2025 for Corinne Ashdown's lost admin rights in Pemberline Dock. I can't see its current status.
